session_summary: Completed a run on Moon Shrine (Route difficulty 2) across 12 steps, engaging in 3 Slime combat encounters, collecting multiple coin nodes, successfully finishing the route with a +25 coin completion bonus, and purchasing the Trail Cap cosmetic for 45 coins with 126 coins remaining.

observations.evidence: Current backlog item 'High-Contrast UI Theme & Focus States' mentions marketplace navigation and UI elements needing clearer keyboard focus rings.
observations.recommendation: Implement high-contrast focus rings and clear visual state indicators for all interactive buttons during keyboard and mouse navigation.

observations.evidence: Marketplace purchase flow successfully executed, providing clear text confirmation ('Purchased and equipped Trail Cap for 45 coins.') and remaining coin balance.
observations.recommendation: Maintain this clear post-purchase feedback pattern across all marketplace items and cosmetic unlocks.

feature_requests.title: Keyboard Shortcut Prompts on Marketplace & HUD
feature_requests.player_value: Allows keyboard-only users to navigate menus instantly without needing to switch to a mouse.
feature_requests.rationale: Clear hotkey indicators reduce cognitive load and improve usability for accessibility-focused players.
feature_requests.desired_outcome: Add visible keyboard shortcut hints (e.g., [1] to buy, [Esc] to close) directly onto UI buttons and marketplace panels.

keep: Clear textual purchase confirmation messages that state item name, cost, and remaining coin balance.
focus: readability, button clarity, cognitive load, feedback, keyboard/mouse usability
